sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Good morning, I'm Tom Hulman, the border czar for President Trump.
sentences.zh: 早上好，我是汤姆·霍曼，特朗普总统的边境沙皇。

sentences.en: I'm here on behalf of the President, along with U.S.
sentences.zh: 我代表总统来到这里，与美国官员同行。

sentences.en: commissioners.
sentences.zh: 委员们。

sentences.en: A few days ago, the President's border czar traveled to Minneapolis with a simple message.
sentences.zh: 几天前，总统的边境沙皇带着一个简单的信息前往明尼阿波利斯。

sentences.en: I didn't ask them to be an immigration officer.
sentences.zh: 我并没有要求他们成为移民官员。

sentences.en: I'm asking them to be cops working with the cops and help us take criminal aliens off the street.
sentences.zh: 我要求他们成为与警察合作的警察，帮助我们把犯罪的非法移民清理出街道。

sentences.en: The faster local officials there cooperate with federal immigration agents, the faster those agents will leave.
sentences.zh: 当地官员与联邦移民特工合作得越快，这些特工离开得就越快。

sentences.en: This is common sense cooperation that allows us to draw down on the number of people we have here.
sentences.zh: 这是常识性的合作，让我们能够减少我们这里的人数。

sentences.en: Yes, I said it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我这么说了。

sentences.en: Draw down the number of people here.
sentences.zh: 减少这里的人数。

sentences.en: Today, the history of why that kind of cooperation is so difficult to pull off and potentially even illegal.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们来探讨为什么那种合作历来如此难以实现，甚至可能违法的前因后果。

sentences.en: I turn to two of my colleagues, Hamid Ali Aziz and Ernesto Londano, to explain.
sentences.zh: 我请我的两位同事哈米德·阿里·阿齐兹和埃内斯托·隆达诺来解释。

sentences.en: Monday, February 2nd.
sentences.zh: 2月2日，星期一。

sentences.en: Hamid, I wonder what you were thinking as a longtime immigration reporter when you heard Tom Homan deliver the message that he did to officials in Minneapolis,
sentences.zh: 哈米德，作为一名资深移民记者，当你听到汤姆·霍曼向明尼阿波利斯的官员传递那样的信息时，你在想什么，

sentences.en: essentially offering that drawdown of federal agents if local officials cooperated and gave access.
sentences.zh: 本质上是提出如果当地官员合作并给予配合，就会撤出联邦特工。

sentences.en: I was thinking Tom Homan was uniquely fit to carry this message for the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 我在想，汤姆·霍曼是为特朗普政府传达这一信息的绝佳人选。

sentences.en: You know, he is somebody who has seen the entire evolution of cooperation between local law enforcement in liberal cities with ICE, with the federal government.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他是那种见证了自由城市的当地执法部门与移民及海关执法局（ICE）以及联邦政府之间合作全过程演变的人。

sentences.en: He's really someone who was there at a time when this was just normal practice at ICE 15 years ago to work closely with local law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 他确实是15年前ICE与当地执法部门紧密合作被视为常规做法时期的亲历者。

sentences.en: And he's been there as it's faded away, as it's become a political issue.
sentences.zh: 他也经历了这种合作逐渐消退、演变成政治议题的整个过程。

sentences.en: And more and more local governments find it unacceptable to work alongside ICE.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的地方政府发现与ICE并肩工作是不可接受的。

sentences.en: And so this is really a battle that Tom Homan has waged for a decade now, not only from his position as leading ICE during that first Trump administration,
sentences.zh: 所以，这实际上是汤姆·霍曼十年来一直在打的一场仗，不仅在他担任第一届特朗普政府ICE领导人的任期内，

sentences.en: but continuously as well on Fox News and testimony to Congress.
sentences.zh: 而且在福克斯新闻的访谈以及对国会的作证中也一直在持续。

sentences.en: This is really a core issue for Tom Homan.
sentences.zh: 这确实是汤姆·霍曼的核心议题。

sentences.en: Well, what is that history that Homan seems to embody of this evolution from cooperation to official non-cooperation?
sentences.zh: 那么，霍曼似乎所体现的这种从合作演变为官方不合作的历史是怎样的？

sentences.en: And where does it start?
sentences.zh: 它又是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: So 15 years ago, during the Obama administration, Tom Homan was leading deportation efforts.
sentences.zh: 所以15年前，在奥巴马政府期间，汤姆·霍曼领导着驱逐出境工作。

sentences.en: He was the person overseeing all deportation officers.
sentences.zh: 他是监督所有驱逐官员的人。

sentences.en: And I think it's important just to know that when someone gets arrested in a local jail, your fingerprints ping to a federal database and that federal database goes to ICE.
sentences.zh: 我认为有一点很重要，当某人在当地监狱被捕时，你的指纹会匹配到一个联邦数据库，而这个数据库会发送给ICE。

sentences.en: So ICE is always aware when someone is arrested, they have records on individuals and they find out if someone that they're looking for is in a county jail.
sentences.zh: 所以ICE总是知道什么时候有人被捕，他们有这些人的记录，并且会查出他们寻找的人是否在某个县监狱里。

sentences.en: And it doesn't matter if it's in the San Francisco or in Alabama.
sentences.zh: 无论是旧金山还是阿拉巴马州，这都是一样的。

sentences.en: And so one of the key strategies for the Obama administration was to utilize jails and prisons to pick up people.
sentences.zh: 因此，奥巴马政府的关键策略之一就是利用监狱来抓人。

sentences.en: And at that time, when it was a less political issue, ICE had the ability to request local jails to hold on to people 48 hours after they're supposed to be released.
sentences.zh: 当时，这还是一个政治色彩较弱的议题，ICE有权要求当地监狱在嫌疑人本应释放后继续关押48小时。

sentences.en: This made things really easy for ICE because they could show up to a jail and they could take multiple people at once.
sentences.zh: 这让ICE的事情变得非常简单，因为他们可以出现在监狱里，一次带走多个人。

sentences.en: and they could arrest them, take them to ICE detention, and deport them.
sentences.zh: 他们可以逮捕他们，带到ICE拘留所，然后将其驱逐出境。

sentences.en: So this made the entire process very efficient, and they really tapped into local jails and prisons across the United States.
sentences.zh: 因此，整个过程变得非常高效，他们真正利用了全美各地的监狱。

sentences.en: So it created a very seamless pipeline from local law enforcement to federal immigration efforts and seemed to be working for more or less both sides.
sentences.zh: 所以它在地方执法部门和联邦移民工作之间创建了一条非常无缝的管道，对双方来说似乎或多或少都在起作用。

sentences.en: Exactly, and they were getting big numbers.
sentences.zh: 没错，他们获得了巨大的数字。

sentences.en: Mr. Holman?
sentences.zh: 霍曼先生？

sentences.en: Unlike you, sir, I've carried a badge and gun for 29 years.
sentences.zh: 和你不同，先生，我佩戴徽章和枪支已经29年了。

sentences.en: I think it's, I care about the security of this country, and I think it's my job to protect the security of this country and security of our communities.
sentences.zh: 我认为，我关心这个国家的安全，我认为保护这个国家和我们社区的安全是我的工作。

sentences.en: So I think the biggest threat is those that want to come to this country do harm.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为最大的威胁是那些想要来到这个国家并造成危害的人。

sentences.en: And this is something that Homan at the time was testifying to in Congress, you know, really speaking to the idea that the Obama administration, their approach, it makes sense.
sentences.zh: 这是霍曼当时在国会作证时所说的事情，你知道，他真正阐明了这样一个观点：奥巴马政府的方法是有道理的。

sentences.en: I've been doing this for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我做这行很久了。

sentences.en: There was a time when I was a street agent, we'd just go out and arrest aliens because they're here in a violation of law, and I'm enforcing immigration law.
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，我是一名街头特工，我们只是出去逮捕非法移民，因为他们违反了法律，而我在执行移民法。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, what impact did I make?
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我产生了什么影响？

sentences.en: At the same time I'm arresting this person that's here illegally, but maybe hasn't committed another crime, there's a child predator walking out of state prison
sentences.zh: 在我逮捕这个非法滞留但可能没有犯下其他罪行的人的同时，有一个儿童掠夺者正走出州监狱，

sentences.en: because we didn't have a presence in all the jails across the country.
sentences.zh: 因为我们在全国所有监狱里都没有驻点。

sentences.en: We're prioritizing the types of people we're arresting.
sentences.zh: 我们在对逮捕的人进行优先级排序。

sentences.en: We're going after the worst of the worst, and we're not just going out there willy-nilly picking up people.
sentences.zh: 我们追捕最坏中的最坏，而不是随随便便地去抓人。

sentences.en: We have a virtual presence in every jail.
sentences.zh: 我们在每个监狱都有虚拟驻点。

sentences.en: When an alien gets arrested and fingerprinted, we're going to find out about that alien, and we can take action on him and remove him from the country.
sentences.zh: 当一名非法移民被捕并按了指纹，我们就会发现这个移民，我们可以对他采取行动并将其驱逐出境。

sentences.en: This jail model really made sense to him.
sentences.zh: 这种监狱模式对他来说确实很有意义。

sentences.en: The strategy ICE has built on prioritizing what we do on national security threat aliens, aliens that are a threat to public safety, it makes sense to me.
sentences.zh: ICE建立的关于优先处理国家安全威胁人员、对公共安全构成威胁人员的策略对我来说是有意义的。

sentences.en: It's the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 这是正确的事情。

sentences.en: We're built to remove 400,000 people.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标是驱逐40万人。

sentences.en: Let's make that 400,000 count.
sentences.zh: 让我们让这40万人发挥作用。

sentences.en: And so when does this start to change?
sentences.zh: 那么这从什么时候开始改变呢？

sentences.en: Well, you know, the Obama administration became so effective at deportations that President Obama started to be labeled the deporter-in-chief.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，奥巴马政府在驱逐出境方面变得如此高效，以至于奥巴马总统开始被称为“首席驱逐官”。

sentences.en: Right, deporter-in-chief not in a good way.
sentences.zh: 对，首席驱逐官，不是在好的意义上。

sentences.en: Exactly, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: He was facing intense criticism from immigrant advocates and certain congressional officials who were quite critical of this approach
sentences.zh: 他面临着来自移民倡导者和某些国会官员的强烈批评，他们对这种每年驱逐数十万人的做法持相当严厉的批评态度。

sentences.en: where they were deporting hundreds of thousands of people a year.
sentences.zh: 而正是在这段时间里，开始出现一种不断增长的理念、一种不断壮大的运动，即城市应该成为移民的避难所，

sentences.en: And during this time, there starts to become a growing idea, a growing movement toward the fact that cities should be a sanctuary for immigrants,
sentences.zh: 他们应该受到保护，免受移民执法的侵害。

sentences.en: that they should be protected from immigration enforcement.
sentences.zh: 对，插话一下，因为我们做过的第一期《每日新闻》节目之一就是关于这种庇护城市的理念。

sentences.en: Right, and just to jump in, because one of the very first episodes of The Daily we ever did was about this idea of a sanctuary city.
sentences.zh: 这个想法实际上源于教堂决定将他们的庇护所变成一个保护无证移民的地方，并蔓延到全国各地，

sentences.en: This idea literally emerges from churches' decisions to turn their sanctuaries into a place that protects undocumented immigrants that spread around the country,
sentences.zh: 最终它在全国各地成为了一个城市法律运动。

sentences.en: and eventually it becomes an urban legal movement in places all over the country.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 庇护运动的一个重点是确保地方执法部门不与ICE合作，不让ICE拥有从地方拘留所到ICE拘留中心并最终驱逐出境的高效通道。

sentences.en: And it becomes a focus for the sanctuary movement to ensure that local law enforcement is not working with ICE and is not allowing ICE to have that efficient funnel of people from local lockups to detention centers for ICE and ultimately deportations.
sentences.zh: 请提醒我们为什么庇护运动最终会聚焦于地方执法部门，他们提出的论点是什么。

sentences.en: And just remind us why the sanctuary movement ends up focusing on local law enforcement, what the argument they're making is.
sentences.zh: 是的，有几个论点。

sentences.en: Yeah, there are several arguments.
sentences.zh: 一个是社区中的移民会更愿意带着线索、犯罪举报走向当地执法部门，

sentences.en: One is the idea that immigrants in a community will feel more willing to come forward to local law enforcement with tips, with reports of crime,
sentences.zh: 更愿意与当地执法部门互动，因为他们知道当地执法部门不与ICE合作。

sentences.en: more willing to interact with local law enforcement because they know that local law enforcement is not working with ICE.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个基础水平上，人们相信这会使社区更安全。

sentences.en: So that base level, there's a belief that it makes communities safer.
sentences.zh: 而且当地监狱通常没有因为与ICE互动、为ICE扣押人员而获得资金、额外的资金。

sentences.en: And then local jails are typically not given money, extra money for interacting with ICE, for holding people for ICE.
sentences.zh: 所以对地方司法管辖区来说有实际的成本。

sentences.en: So there is a real cost to local jurisdictions.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在那段时间里，当ICE让这些监狱更长时间地扣押人员以便他们可以去接人时，

sentences.en: And, you know, around that time, when ICE is getting these jails to hold people for a longer period of time so that they could come and pick them up,
sentences.zh: 发生了几起诉讼，其中不应该被ICE额外扣押的人被关押了。

sentences.en: there were several lawsuits in which individuals who should not have been held longer for ICE were locked up.
sentences.zh: 我认为这也让其中一些社区产生了犹豫。

sentences.en: And I think that gave pause to some of these communities as well.
sentences.zh: 为了解释清楚，

sentences.en: And just to explain,
sentences.zh: 他们面临诉讼是因为那些被额外多关押几天的移民，为了让ICE能够来接他们，实际上是在我们讨论的任何司法管辖区代表下，面临着非法的额外惩罚，仅仅是为了让ICE有机会将他们驱逐出境。

sentences.en: they're facing lawsuits because those immigrants who are being held for extra days in order for ICE to be able to come and get them are essentially facing an illegal extra punishment on behalf of whatever jurisdiction we're talking about just so that ICE has a chance to deport them.
sentences.zh: 他们在起诉，听起来在某些情况下他们赢了。

sentences.en: They're suing and sounds like in some cases they're winning.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 我认为这些诉讼向地方监狱和地方政治家表明，当ICE犯错时，你将承担责任。

sentences.en: And I think what these lawsuits showed local jails and local politicians was that when there's a mistake made by ICE, you're going to be on the hook.
sentences.zh: 你是那个会被起诉的人。

sentences.en: You're the one who's going to be sued.
sentences.zh: 你是那个将面临这种额外审查的人。

sentences.en: You're the one who's going to face this extra scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 我认为这为美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）等组织提供了更多弹药来指出这一点，说：你不想卷入其中。

sentences.en: And I think it let more ammo to organizations like the ACLU to point this out, to say, you don't want to get involved with this.
sentences.zh: 你应该设法摆脱这种潜在的责任。

sentences.en: You should try to rid yourself of this potential liability.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 留给ICE去做。

sentences.en: Leave it to ICE.
sentences.zh: 让他们做他们需要做的事，但不要帮他们。

sentences.en: Let them do what they need to do, but don't help them.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 你知道，移民系统和刑事司法系统应该保持独立。

sentences.en: You know, the immigration system and the criminal justice system should remain separate.
sentences.zh: 活动人士和移民倡导者提出的一种论点是，ICE抓获的一些人在被捕后甚至可能没有被起诉，

sentences.en: And there's an argument from activists and immigrant advocates that some of these individuals that ICE has picked up have been maybe not even charged after they've been arrested,
sentences.zh: 或者指控最终没有导致定罪。

sentences.en: or the charges ultimately don't lead to the conviction.
sentences.zh: 所以这些人并不一定符合罪犯的定义，但他们被捕并被扔进了刑事司法系统。

sentences.en: And so these are individuals who don't necessarily meet the definition of a criminal, but they've been arrested and thrown into the criminal justice system.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们正以不应该的方式被移交给ICE。

sentences.en: And as a result, they are being transferred to ICE in a way that they should not be.
sentences.zh: 所以，哈米德，一旦这种不合作的理念扎根，它看起来是什么样的，范围有多广？

sentences.en: So, Hamid, once this idea of non-cooperation settles in, what does that look like and how broad does it become?
sentences.zh: 你知道，正是在这段时间里，在奥巴马政府末期，

sentences.en: You know, it's during this time, toward the end of the Obama administration,
sentences.zh: 像加利福尼亚州这样地方开始反抗延长关押期以便ICE来接人的做法。

sentences.en: where places like California buck back at the idea of holding people longer so that ICE can come pick them up.
sentences.zh: 所以你会看到奥巴马政府真的在想办法，而且这正是在汤姆·霍曼在那里的时候，去与这些自由派司法管辖区合作。

sentences.en: So you see the Obama administration really try to figure out a way, and this is during a time when Tom Homan's there, to work with these liberal jurisdictions.
sentences.zh: 所以他们想出了这样一个主意，好吧，你们不必为我们延长关押某人的时间，

sentences.en: So they come up with this idea that, okay, you don't have to hold on to somebody longer for us,
sentences.zh: 但是在某人释放前48小时通知我们怎么样，这样我们就可以去监狱接他们了？

sentences.en: but how about you notify us 48 hours before somebody's released from custody so that we could be there at the jail and pick them up?
sentences.zh: 所有这些责任，所有这些潜在的诉讼，嘿，你都不用担心。

sentences.en: All that liability, all those potential lawsuits, hey, you don't have to worry about that.
sentences.zh: 只要在释放某人之前给我们打个招呼，你就不需要延长关押他们。

sentences.en: Just give us a heads up before someone's released, and you don't need to hold on to them longer.
sentences.zh: 所以某种低水平的合作仍在发生。

sentences.en: So some low level of cooperation is still happening.
sentences.zh: 是的，联邦政府将其作为一个选项提供。

sentences.en: Yeah, the federal government offers it as an option.
sentences.zh: 但随后唐纳德·特朗普以打击移民和驱逐许多移民为由赢得了总统职位。

sentences.en: But then Donald Trump wins the presidency on the basis of cracking down on immigration and deporting many immigrants.
sentences.zh: 因此，这成为许多这些进步派城市限制哪怕是那种程度合作的一个原因。

sentences.en: And so it becomes a cause for many of these progressive cities to limit even that level of collaboration.
sentences.zh: 在这期间，加利福尼亚州出台了一项广泛的庇护州政策，真正限制了，

sentences.en: During this time, California puts in place an expansive sanctuary state policy, really limiting,
sentences.zh: 严格限制了地方执法部门与ICE之间的合作和互动。

sentences.en: severely limiting the cooperation and interaction between local law enforcement and ICE.
sentences.zh: 很快你就会看到全国各地的城市和司法管辖区采纳这种限制与联邦政府和ICE进行任何类型合作的想法，因为这被视为帮助特朗普总统的一种方式。

sentences.en: And soon you start seeing cities and jurisdictions across the country taking up this idea of limiting any type of cooperation with the federal government and with ICE because it was seen as a way of helping President Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上在这一点上，任何形式的合作大门都被关上了。

sentences.en: So basically at this point, the door comes down on any form of any cooperation.
sentences.zh: 是的，它变得非常有限。

sentences.en: Yeah, it becomes really limited.
sentences.zh: 我是说，监狱为ICE想要的移民提供释放日期信息的权限被限制在一种非常特定类型的暴力罪犯身上，

sentences.en: I mean, the ability for a jail to provide the release date information for an immigrant that ICE wants became limited for a very specific type of violent criminal,
sentences.zh: 一种非常严重的罪犯。

sentences.en: a very serious criminal.
sentences.zh: 这使得像汤姆·霍曼这样的人的生活变得更加困难，当特朗普上台时，他被安排去管理ICE。

sentences.en: And that made life much more difficult for people like Tom Homan, who, by the time Trump comes into office, he's put in place to run ICE.
sentences.zh: 他真的把加利福尼亚州和庇护管辖权、庇护州的整个想法当作了他的一项事业。

sentences.en: And he really makes California and this whole idea of a sanctuary jurisdiction, a sanctuary state, a cause for him.
sentences.zh: 他无休止地关注它。

sentences.en: He focuses on it relentlessly.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，庇护城市引发了严重的警员安全和社区安全问题。

sentences.en: Sanctuary cities, I think, in my opinion, raise a serious officer safety and community safety issue.
sentences.zh: 而这段时间的许多信息与我们现在听到信息非常相似。

sentences.en: And much of the message during this time is very similar to the message that we're hearing now.
sentences.zh: 我在庇护城市的县监狱里每多逮捕一个人，就意味着执法人员少去一个家庭敲门去逮捕一个有犯罪记录的人，而本可以在县监狱的安全、安心和隐私中逮捕他们。

sentences.en: For every person that I can arrest in a county jail in a sanctuary city means that a law enforcement officer has a knock on the door of a home to arrest somebody that has a criminal history when they could have arrested them in the safety and security and privacy of a county jail.
sentences.zh: 2017年6月，他来到国会山告诉他们，庇护城市的想法使社区变得不安全，

sentences.en: In June of 2017, he goes in front of Congress and he tells them that the idea of sanctuary cities makes it less safe for communities,
sentences.zh: 不仅通过向社区释放所谓的罪犯，还让ICE更难找到这些人。

sentences.en: not only by releasing alleged criminals into the communities, but making it harder for ICE to find these people.
sentences.zh: 这只是时间问题，当ICE的男男女女晚上不能回家，因为他们不得不去家里逮捕一个犯罪移民，

sentences.en: It's only a matter of time before when the men and women of ICE don't go home at night because they had to go arrest a criminal alien in a home
sentences.zh: 而不是在庇护城市的县监狱里抓到他们。

sentences.en: rather than get them in a county jail in a sanctuary city.
sentences.zh: 庇护城市对ICE的男男女女构成了危险。

sentences.en: The sanctuary cities are a danger to the men and women of ICE.
sentences.zh: 当他们进入这些社区，去到家里并试图进行这些逮捕时，发生暴力对抗的可能性就更大，

sentences.en: And when they go into these communities and they go to homes and they try to make these arrests, there's a greater possibility of a violent confrontation,
sentences.zh: 人们处于危险之中的可能性更大。

sentences.en: of people being in danger.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，更多的人仅仅因为身处某些目标附近而被捕。

sentences.en: And on top of that, more people being arrested just for being around some of the targets.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说，当我们无法获得我们认为需要的权限——特别是对你们监狱的权限时，ICE和整体移民执法处于最糟糕、最具对抗性的状态

sentences.en: He's basically saying ICE and immigration enforcement in general is at its worst and its most confrontational when we don't get the access that we believe we need
sentences.zh: 特别对你们的监狱。

sentences.en: to your jails in particular.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 但最终，特朗普变得更加严厉。

sentences.en: But ultimately, Trump became harsher.
sentences.zh: 但最终，特朗普变得更加严厉。

sentences.en: His language became more aggressive.
sentences.zh: 他的用词变得更加强硬。

sentences.en: And these cities and these jurisdictions, really there was no pathway for them to come back online and work with ICE.
sentences.zh: 而对于这些城市和司法管辖区来说，实际上已经没有途径让他们恢复上线并与移民及海关执法局合作了。

sentences.en: It was seen as the only way or one of the main ways for these communities to protect their immigrants
sentences.zh: 这被认为是这些社区保护移民的唯一途径或主要途径之一

sentences.en: from the onslaught that Trump was bringing to them during that first Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 以抵御特朗普在第一任期内给他们带来的冲击。

sentences.en: And ultimately, Homan and the administration's efforts to sue California over this really expansive, unprecedented statewide sanctuary policy, that failed.
sentences.zh: 最终，霍曼和政府试图就这种规模宏大、史无前例的全州庇护政策起诉加利福尼亚州的努力失败了。

sentences.en: And Homan and ICE, they weren't able to get more access to jails.
sentences.zh: 而霍曼和移民及海关执法局并没有获得更多进入看守所的权限。

sentences.en: They got less.
sentences.zh: 他们得到的反而更少了。

sentences.en: So by the time Tom Homan ends up in Minneapolis last week and is telling local officials,
sentences.zh: 因此，当汤姆·霍曼上周来到明尼阿波利斯并对当地官员说

sentences.en: just give us access to your jails and everything will be copacetic, he knows full well, because he's lived through the whole history of this, that that's not a simple thing.
sentences.zh: 只要让我们进入你们的看守所，一切就都好办了——他心里很清楚，因为他经历过这段完整的历史，事情并没有那么简单。

sentences.en: It's been legally codified as unacceptable in many, many places around the country.
sentences.zh: 在全国许多地方，这在法律上已被明文规定为不可接受的。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全如此。

sentences.en: You know, Homan is well aware.
sentences.zh: 你知道，霍曼心知肚明。

sentences.en: He knows that this idea of working closely with ICE, allowing ICE into local jails in Minneapolis is a political non-starter.
sentences.zh: 他知道，这种与移民及海关执法局密切合作、允许其进入明尼阿波利斯当地看守所的想法在政治上是根本行不通的。

sentences.en: But he also recognizes that the idea of allowing some cooperation, some effort to work with ICE could really be a way, an off-ramp for both sides
sentences.zh: 但他也认识到，允许某种程度的合作、尝试与移民及海关执法局合作的想法，确实可以为双方提供一条退路

sentences.en: to say that they won something in this battle and now they can move on from this crisis.
sentences.zh: 让他们可以说自己在这场博弈中赢得了某些东西，现在可以从这场危机中走出来了。

sentences.en: Mohamed, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: After the break, Ernesto Londano on how Minneapolis is navigating the Trump administration's latest demands for cooperation.
sentences.zh: 广告之后，埃内斯托·隆达诺将为您讲述明尼阿波利斯如何应对特朗普政府最新的合作要求。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是刘温娜。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《纽约时报》游戏旗下的拼字游戏《连线》（Connections），而且我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗狗，也喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责创作《拼字蜜蜂》（Spelling Bee）和《连字格》（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色彩联觉（promesthesia）的奇妙感知。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像刚才你们听到声音的那几位一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始游玩吧。

sentences.en: Ernesto, you're in Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 埃内斯托，你现在在明尼阿波利斯。

sentences.en: It's where you live.
sentences.zh: 那是你居住的地方。

sentences.en: Talk to us about how these demands for cooperation from Tom Hohman and the administration to leaders in Minneapolis are playing out there on the ground.
sentences.zh: 跟我们聊聊，汤姆·霍曼和政府向明尼阿波利斯领导层提出的这些合作要求，在当地实际是如何展开的。

sentences.en: Well, Tom Hohman has been here for a couple of days.
sentences.zh: 嗯，汤姆·霍曼已经在这里待了几天了。

sentences.en: He's met with the governor, with the mayor of Minneapolis, with the mayor of St. Paul.
sentences.zh: 他会见了州长、明尼阿波利斯市长以及圣保罗市长。

sentences.en: But arguably, I think the most consequential meeting he's had is one of the ones that has drawn the least amount of attention.
sentences.zh: 但可以说，我认为他进行的最重要的一次会面，反而是受关注度最低的一次。

sentences.en: He met with Hennepin County Sheriff Dawana Witt.
sentences.zh: 他会见了亨内平县治安官达瓦娜·维特。

sentences.en: The reason this matters is that Sheriff Witt oversees the largest jail in the state.
sentences.zh: 这件事之所以重要，是因为维特治安官管理着该州最大的看守所。

sentences.en: And the only one that has a clear-cut policy saying that they will not cooperate with ICE.
sentences.zh: 并且，这是唯一一个拥有明确政策、声明绝不与移民及海关执法局合作的看守所。

sentences.en: So if there's one person in the state currently who could, as a matter of policy under her authority,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果说该州目前还有哪个人，能够作为她职权范围内的政策决定

sentences.en: you know, kind of give the administration a big win, a trophy, so to speak, to, you know, walk away from this immigration crackdown, it's Sheriff Witt.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，给政府送上一场大胜，可以说是送上一座奖杯，好让他们，你知道的，从这场移民打击行动中抽身离去，那个人就是维特治安官。

sentences.en: And what's the story of this jail, this jail that it sounds like Tom Homan is very focused on and its non-relationship to immigration enforcement?
sentences.zh: 这个看守所有着怎样的故事？听起来汤姆·霍曼对这个看守所以及它与移民执法部门没有关系的状态非常关注。

sentences.en: Yeah, this jail has a really interesting story that really dovetails the broader journey of the sanctuary movement in the United States.
sentences.zh: 是的，这个看守所背后有一个非常有趣的故事，它实际上与美国庇护运动的整体历程高度契合。

sentences.en: So, you know, if you rewind the tape a little bit and go back to the Obama years, the Hennepin County Jail had a policy where they actually allowed ICE agents to keep
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，如果把时间倒回一点，回到奥巴马执政时期，亨内平县看守所曾有一项政策：他们实际上允许移民及海关执法局的特工在设施内保留

sentences.en: a tiny little office in the facility.
sentences.zh: 一个极小的办公室。

sentences.en: It was like the equivalent of a broom closet.
sentences.zh: 大概就相当于一个扫帚间那么大。

sentences.en: And what the sheriff here at the time did was he allowed agents to interview immigrants who were booked into the jail to assess whether or not they were deportable
sentences.zh: 当时这里的治安官所做的事是，他允许特工对被关押进看守所的移民进行面谈，以评估他们是否属于可被驱逐出境的人员

sentences.en: and to figure out whether or not ICE wanted to grab them the moment that they were no longer going to be in state custody.
sentences.zh: 并弄清楚移民及海关执法局是否希望在这些人不再处于州政府拘留状态的那一刻将他们抓走。

sentences.en: That's really fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这真的很让人着迷。

sentences.en: That's so hand in glove.
sentences.zh: 配合得真是天衣无缝。

sentences.en: That's a deep level of coordination.
sentences.zh: 那是一种深度的协调。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And sheriffs in Minnesota are elected officials.
sentences.zh: 明尼苏达州的治安官是民选官员。

sentences.en: So they have to run for office and be responsive to what the electorate is feeling and thinking about these issues.
sentences.zh: 因此他们必须竞选公职，并对选民对这些议题的感受和看法做出回应。

sentences.en: And in the 2018 election, the sheriff, who had been in office for over a decade, lost his race by a tiny margin.
sentences.zh: 在2018年的选举中，这位已经任职十多年的治安官以微弱劣势输掉了竞选。

sentences.en: And one of the issues that the guy who beat him campaigned on was rescinding cooperation with ICE.
sentences.zh: 击败他的人在竞选时主张的核心议题之一就是取消与移民及海关执法局的合作。

sentences.en: So we were in a moment where people were outraged by the family separation policy that the Trump administration had been pursuing,
sentences.zh: 当时人们对特朗普政府推行的骨肉分离政策感到愤怒

sentences.en: and immigration had become both a very divisive and a very partisan issue.
sentences.zh: 移民问题已经变成了一个极具分裂性和党派色彩的议题。

sentences.en: So you have a new sheriff who comes into office at this fraught political time over immigration and over a period of months, wound down cooperation with ICE,
sentences.zh: 因此，在新治安官上任时，正值移民问题政治气氛高度紧张的时期。经过几个月的时间，她逐步终止了与移民及海关执法局的合作

sentences.en: initially by kicking them out of the jail and eventually by not notifying them when immigrants who were subject to deportation were booked or informing ICE when individuals were going to be due for release.
sentences.zh: 最初是把他们赶出看守所，最后发展到在面临驱逐的移民被关押时不再通知他们，或者在个人即将被释放时也不知会移民及海关执法局。

sentences.en: So no more broom closet for ICE, basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上，移民及海关执法局再也没有扫帚间可用了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 一点没错。

sentences.en: They were out.
sentences.zh: 他们出局了。

sentences.en: However, I think it's important to remember that there was still a significant amount of cooperation with ICE when you looked at the state prison system,
sentences.zh: 不过，我认为重要的一点是，当你审视州监狱系统时，你会发现他们与移民及海关执法局之间仍然存在相当大程度的合作

sentences.en: which as a matter of both statute and policy, they always notify ICE when an individual who is serving time on a serious charge is going to be released.
sentences.zh: 根据成文法和政策，每当因严重罪行服刑的个人即将被释放时，他们总是会通知移民及海关执法局。

sentences.en: And those individuals are handed over to ICE in a very kind of pragmatic and cooperative style.
sentences.zh: 而这些个人会以一种非常务实且合作的方式被移交给移民及海关执法局。

sentences.en: You just call up the ICE agent, let them know, be here at such and such prison at nine in the morning, and here's your guy from our custody to yours.
sentences.zh: 你只需要给移民及海关执法局的特工打个电话通知一声，让他们早上九点到某某监狱来，然后人就从我们这里移交到你们手上了。

sentences.en: When it comes to other jails in the state, it's been a little trickier.
sentences.zh: 至于该州的其他看守所，情况就比较棘手了。

sentences.en: I think it varies sheriff to sheriff just how much effort and time they want to put into cooperating with ICE.
sentences.zh: 我认为各个治安官愿意在与移民及海关执法局合作上投入多少精力和时间，因人而异。

sentences.en: And in the past, this issue has been legally challenging for counties in the state.
sentences.zh: 在过去，这个问题给该州的各县带来了法律上的挑战。

sentences.en: There's been lawsuits in at least a couple of jurisdictions that resulted in payouts to immigrants after the courts found that local jails had exceeded their authority in detaining
sentences.zh: 至少在几个司法管辖区发生过诉讼，结果是法院裁定当地看守所在应移民及海关执法局的要求、延长

sentences.en: people at ISIS request longer that they legally had permission to do so.
sentences.zh: 超过其合法许可期限关押人员时超出了其职权范围，从而导致了对移民的赔偿。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: Hamid had talked about this phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 哈米德曾谈到过这种现象。

sentences.en: It ends up being the case that the jails and the communities where these jails are located are on the hook financially for those legal
sentences.zh: 结果往往是，这些看守所以及这些看守所所在的社区，必须在财政上承担那些法律

sentences.en: challenges, which becomes a real disincentive to play ball.
sentences.zh: 挑战的后果，这使得他们极不愿意配合。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: But I think what you have is a mix of sheriffs here, you know, in suburban counties and rural counties, I would say, you know, most sheriffs cooperate with ICE to some degree.
sentences.zh: 但我想你所看到的是这里治安官的一种混合状态，你知道的，在郊区县和农村县，我想说，你知道的，大多数治安官在某种程度上都与移民及海关执法局合作。

sentences.en: The one exception continues to be Hennepin County, which up to this point maintains that they do not intend to work with ICE in any way, shape, or form.
sentences.zh: 唯一的例外依然是亨内平县，到目前为止，该县坚称他们不打算以任何形式、任何方式与移民及海关执法局合作。

sentences.en: Well, talk about the position that this Hennepin County sheriff is now in.
sentences.zh: 好的，谈谈这位亨内平县治安官目前所处的立场。

sentences.en: She's got the federal government in the form of Tom Homan bearing down on her and saying, we're asking this one thing.
sentences.zh: 以汤姆·霍曼为代表的联邦政府正向她施压，并表示：我们只要求这一件事。

sentences.en: And I have to imagine, in a sense, they're making her feel like she stands in the way
sentences.zh: 我甚至可以想象，从某种意义上说，他们让她觉得正是她在阻挠

sentences.en: of ICE and Border Patrol drawing down their numbers in Minneapolis because she's standing there and saying, I won't give you this thing you want.
sentences.zh: 移民及海关执法局和边境巡逻队在明尼阿波利斯削减人员规模，因为她就站在那里说：我不会给你你想要的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's really interesting because in the messaging from the Trump administration, You know, they've gone really hard after Governor Tim Walz, after Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Fry.
sentences.zh: 是的，这真的很有趣，因为从特朗普政府的信息传递来看，你知道的，他们对州长蒂姆·沃尔兹、明尼阿波利斯市长雅各布·弗雷进行了非常严厉的抨击。

sentences.en: But both of them have essentially said, we either already cooperate with ICE, as it pertains to the governor and the prison system, and the mayor has no oversight over jails.
sentences.zh: 但他们两人基本上都表态说，就州长和监狱系统而言，我们其实已经与移民及海关执法局合作了，而市长对看守所没有监督权。

sentences.en: So I think everybody's starting to look at Dewana Witt, the sheriff, and say, if there's one person who could, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为每个人都开始把目光投向治安官达瓦娜·维特，并说：如果说有哪个人能够，你知道的

sentences.en: make a real substantive move that might appease the Trump administration, it's Dewana.
sentences.zh: 做出一个实质性的举动来安抚特朗普政府，那个人就是达瓦娜。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: The problem, though, is, you know, here is somebody who needs to be elected and be responsive to her constituents.
sentences.zh: 然而问题在于，你知道的，这个人必须通过选举产生，并对她的选民负责。

sentences.en: And Dewana Witt got elected in the aftermath of the George Floyd era, you know, where the politics in Minneapolis and the county, you know, really veered to the left.
sentences.zh: 而达瓦娜·维特正是在乔治·弗洛伊德事件之后当选的，当时明尼阿波利斯和该县的政治风向，你知道的，确实向左翼倾斜了。

sentences.en: And she's somebody who I think is at heart a centrist in her political philosophy.
sentences.zh: 我认为她从政治哲学内核来看是一个温和派。

sentences.en: She's somebody who I think is a pragmatiSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为她是一个务实主义者。

sentences.en: But she sort of rode the wave of anger that followed the killing of George Floyd during a time when people were really upset at the Trump administration, where immigrant right
sentences.zh: 但她某种程度上顺应了乔治·弗洛伊德遇害后随之而来的愤怒浪潮，当时人们对特朗普政府非常不满，移民权利

sentences.en: groups had a lot of political power.
sentences.zh: 组织拥有很大的政治影响力。

sentences.en: So if she were to make a move that her constituents would see as her having capitulated to the
sentences.zh: 因此，如果她做出一个让选民认为是对特朗普政府屈服的举动

sentences.en: Trump administration and essentially flinging the doors to the jail open to ICE, you would assume that would be politically damaging for her in this moment.
sentences.zh: 并且实质上向移民及海关执法局敞开了看守所的大门，你可以想象这在此时对她的政治生涯将是极具破坏性的。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So what has she said about what she plans to do?
sentences.zh: 那么她对自己的下一步计划说了些什么？

sentences.en: She has said very little publicly.
sentences.zh: 她在公开场合表态极少。

sentences.en: She's been very critical of the way immigration agents have conducted business over the past few weeks.
sentences.zh: 她对过去几周移民特工执法时的行事方式提出了严厉批评。

sentences.en: You know, they've killed two American citizens here.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们在这里已经杀害了两名美国公民。

sentences.en: These immigration rates have been very chaotic and disruptive.
sentences.zh: 这些针对移民的突击搜查非常混乱且极具破坏性。

sentences.en: But Dewanowicz so far has not really inserted herself, publicly at least, into this conversation about jails and prisons.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，达瓦娜·维特并没有真正把自己，至少在公开场合，卷入到这场关于看守所和监狱的讨论中。

sentences.en: I've been trying to interview her, but she hasn't really been ready to come out and engage and, you know, say whether or not she's willing to, you know,
sentences.zh: 我一直试图采访她，但她并没有准备好站出来表态并参与其中，你知道的，也没有说她是否愿意，你知道的

sentences.en: be the one who makes a bold move as part of the standoff.
sentences.zh: 成为在这场对峙中做出大胆举动的人。

sentences.en: The readout she put out about her meeting with Tom Homan was very short and, you know, somewhat vague.
sentences.zh: 她就与汤姆·霍曼会面一事发布的通报非常简短，而且，你知道的，有些含糊其辞。

sentences.en: She called their conversation candid and constructive, but she did not indicate in any way, shape,
sentences.zh: 她称他们的谈话坦诚且富有建设性，但她并没有以任何形式、任何方式暗示

sentences.en: or form that she's starting to revisit her policy at the jail or that there could be a deal on the table that she's exploring.
sentences.zh: 她开始重新审视看守所的政策，或者桌面上有什么她正在探讨的协议。

sentences.en: Just to understand, because you're mostly talking about the political predicament that this sheriff is in, legally, even if she wanted to,
sentences.zh: 为了解清楚，因为你主要在谈论这位治安官所处的政治困境，从法律角度讲，即使她愿意的话

sentences.en: could Sheriff Witt cooperate with the federal government and open up the jail?
sentences.zh: 维特治安官能够与联邦政府合作并开放看守所以吗？

sentences.en: So it's my understanding that there's kind of two overlapping things happening here.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，这里有两件相互交织的事情在发生。

sentences.en: One is at the county level, policy is set by county commissioners who are also elected officials, and they have a separation ordinance as it pertains to ICE cooperation, but it,
sentences.zh: 一方面是在县级层面，政策由同为民选官员的县委员制定，他们针对与移民及海关执法局的合作制定了隔离条例，但它

sentences.en: you know, addresses kind of simple issues, such as the fact that county property and parking lots can't be used by ICE agents to stage their operations.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，解决的是一些简单的问题，比如县级财产和停车场不能被移民及海关执法局特工用作其行动的集结地。

sentences.en: When it comes to the jail, my understanding is that Sheriff Witt could unilaterally decide to change the policy, for instance,
sentences.zh: 至于看守所，据我了解，维特治安官可以单方面决定更改政策，例如

sentences.en: to start providing information to ICE or to open up a line of communication between her office and the local ICE agents and to start heeding their requests for information about when somebody's going to be released.
sentences.zh: 开始向移民及海关执法局提供信息，或者在她办公室与当地移民及海关执法局特工之间开辟一条沟通渠道，并开始理会他们关于某人何时释放的信息请求。

sentences.en: You know, she could theoretically also decide to once again open the jail to ICE agents and to allow them kind of easy access.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，理论上她也可以决定再次向移民及海关执法局开放看守所，并允许他们相对轻松地进入。

sentences.en: It is, as I understand it, within her purview.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，这完全在她的职权范围内。

sentences.en: But politically, I think it'd be a really difficult and conceivably damaging move for a sheriff who I think intends to run for re-election.
sentences.zh: 但在政治上，我认为对于一个打算竞选连任的治安官来说，这将是一个非常困难且可能具有破坏性的举动。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: And the question would be, if she were to let ICE Border Patrol start coordinating with the jail, to what end exactly?
sentences.zh: 问题在于，如果她让移民及海关执法局和边境巡逻队开始与看守所进行协调，究竟是为了什么目的？

sentences.en: Because at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 因为归根结底

sentences.en: what kind of assurances do any of these local officials have in Minneapolis or really anywhere in the country that if they meet Tom Homan's demands and the administration's demands,
sentences.zh: 明尼阿波利斯的任何这些地方官员，或者实际上全国任何地方的官员，有什么样的保证认为，如果他们满足了汤姆·霍曼的要求和政府的要求

sentences.en: if they fling open the doors to this jail, if they let ICE back into a broom closet in the corner and coordinate release and then arrest and deportation,
sentences.zh: 如果他们向这个看守所敞开大门，如果他们让移民及海关执法局重新回到角落里的扫帚间并协调释放、逮捕和驱逐程序

sentences.en: that then ICE and Border Patrol agents would start to leave the city or that their operations would go back to being less confrontational.
sentences.zh: 那么移民及海关执法局和边境巡逻队的特工就会开始离开这座城市，或者他们的行动会恢复到以前那种对抗性较低的状态。

sentences.en: I mean, there's absolutely no guarantee that if you make this gesture, if you were to open Hennepin County Jail to them, that this would all go away.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，绝对没有任何保证说，如果你做出这种姿态，如果你向他们开放亨内平县看守所，这一切就会烟消云散。

sentences.en: You know, it's hard to overstate how little trust exists currently between elected officials in the state and the Trump administration on these issues.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，怎么强调都不过分的是，目前该州民选官员与特朗普政府在这些问题上缺乏信任到了何种地步。

sentences.en: This is a state where people feel besieged by the federal government.
sentences.zh: 这是一个人们觉得自己遭到联邦政府围困的州。

sentences.en: They feel that this operation is really, really doing serious damage to people's livelihoods.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这次行动实实在在地对人们的生计造成了严重的损害。

sentences.en: It's resulted in two deaths already.
sentences.zh: 它已经导致了两起死亡事件。

sentences.en: And it's really strained longstanding relationships between local and federal law enforcement agencies.
sentences.zh: 它确实使地方和联邦执法机构之间长期存在的关系变得紧张。

sentences.en: But it also, you know, boils down to the principle about these policies.
sentences.zh: 但你知道的，归根结底还是这些政策的原则问题。

sentences.en: The reason some police departments and the Hennepin County Sheriff's Office have decided they don't want to be involved in immigration stuff is because they feel it erodes trust with the community they serve.
sentences.zh: 一些警察局和亨内平县治安官办公室之所以决定不想卷入移民事务，是因为他们觉得这会侵蚀他们所服务的社区对他们的信任。

sentences.en: So if they were to make a big concession on this, they would be essentially capitulating on a matter of principle, and they would be doing so with no guarantee
sentences.zh: 因此，如果他们在这方面做出重大让步，他们基本上就是在原则问题上屈服，而且这样做没有任何保证

sentences.en: that this would subject them to less pressure from the Trump administration or even less immigration enforcement out in the streets.
sentences.zh: 能让他们免受特朗普政府更大的压力，甚至免受街头更严厉的移民执法。

sentences.en: Well, Ernesto, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，埃内斯托，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们深表感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。
